blackstoneRecipes.title: Classic Blackstone Smash Burgers
steps: Preheat Blackstone to high heat (450–500°F). Lightly oil surface.
Divide beef into 4 loose balls (do not compress).
Place beef on hot surface and immediately smash thin using a heavy spatula.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Cook undisturbed 2–3 minutes until crispy edges form.
Flip using scraper, add cheese, cook 1–2 more minutes.
Toast buttered buns on medium zone.
Assemble and serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chicken Fajitas
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Toss chicken with oil and seasoning.
Cook chicken 6–8 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Move chicken to cooler zone.
Cook peppers and onions until softened and slightly charred.
Combine and heat through.
Warm tortillas on low heat zone.
Serve hot.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Breakfast Hash with Eggs
steps: Preheat one zone to medium (375°F) and one to low.
Cook sausage until browned (internal 160°F). Move aside.
Add potatoes with oil and cook 12–15 minutes until crispy.
Add onion and pepper; cook until softened.
Mix sausage back in.
Create wells and crack eggs into wells.
Cook until whites set and yolks reach preference.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Street Corn (Elote)
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Place corn directly on surface and rotate every 2–3 minutes.
Cook until evenly charred (8–10 minutes total).
Brush with butter.
Spread thin layer of mayo.
Sprinkle cotija and chili powder.
Finish with fresh lime juice.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Pancakes
steps: Preheat griddle to 350°F (medium-low).
Mix pancake mix with milk and eggs until thickened.
Lightly grease surface.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form (2–3 minutes).
Flip and cook another 2 minutes until golden.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Grilled Cheese
steps: Preheat to medium (350°F).
Butter bread evenly.
Place butter-side down.
Add cheese and top slice.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Hibachi Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Preheat to medium-high (400°F).
Cook diced chicken to 165°F internal.
Scramble eggs separately.
Add vegetables and cook until tender.
Add rice and break apart.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Combine everything and cook until lightly crisped.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Butter Ribeye Steak
steps: Preheat griddle to high (500°F).
Season steaks generously.
Sear 3–4 minutes per side.
Reduce heat slightly and add butter and garlic.
Baste steaks until internal temp reaches 130°F for medium-rare.
Rest 5–10 minutes before slicing.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Shrimp Tacos
steps: Preheat to medium-high (400°F).
Season shrimp.
Cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 48-52°C, then add the onion and bell pepper and sauté with the shrimp for 3 minutes.
Warm tortillas.
Assemble tacos and serve.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Preheat to medium-high (400°F).
Add oil and vegetables.
Cook 6–8 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add soy sauce.
Cook 1–2 more minutes and serve.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Philly Cheesesteak
steps: Preheat Blackstone to medium-high (400°F).
Add oil and cook onions and peppers until soft and lightly caramelized (6–8 minutes). Move to cooler zone.
Increase heat to high (450°F). Spread steak evenly across surface.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook 2–3 minutes, chopping and flipping until browned (internal temp 135–140°F for medium).
Mix vegetables back into steak.
Divide into 4 portions and top each with 2 slices provolone.
Allow cheese to melt, then scoop into toasted hoagie rolls.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Breakfast Burritos
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook sausage until browned (internal 160°F). Move aside.
Cook hash browns until crispy (10–12 minutes).
Scramble eggs in butter on low zone until softly set (internal 160°F).
Warm tortillas briefly.
Assemble with sausage, eggs, hash browns and cheese.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down 1–2 minutes.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Carne Asada Street Tacos
steps: Marinate steak 30 minutes with oil, lime, garlic and spices.
Preheat griddle to high (450–500°F).
Sear steak 4–5 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 130°F (medium-rare).
Rest 5–10 minutes before slicing thin against the grain.
Warm tortillas on medium zone.
Assemble tacos with steak, onion and cilantro.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Season chicken and heat through to 165°F.
Butter griddle lightly.
Place tortilla, add cheese and chicken evenly.
Fold and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Slice and serve.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Cajun Shrimp
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Toss shrimp with oil and Cajun seasoning.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 120–125°F.
Add butter and toss briefly.
Serve immediately with lemon.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Preheat to medium-high (400°F).
Cook chicken 5–6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Brush with teriyaki sauce during last 2 minutes.
Cook vegetables separately until tender-crisp.
Slice chicken and serve with vegetables.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Bacon and Eggs Full Griddle
steps: Preheat one zone to medium (375°F).
Cook bacon 4–5 minutes, flipping occasionally.
Move bacon to cooler zone.
Crack eggs onto lightly greased surface.
Cook until whites set and yolks reach preference.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Sausage and Peppers
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook sausages 12–15 minutes turning frequently until internal temp 160°F.
Slice peppers and onions.
Cook vegetables until softened and slightly caramelized.
Slice sausages and mix with vegetables.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Loaded Nachos
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (350°F).
Heat ground beef to 160°F.
Layer chips on foil tray.
Top with beef and cheese.
Cover with dome lid to melt cheese.
Add toppings and serve.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Griddle Pizza
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-low (350°F).
Stretch dough and brush bottom with oil.
Cook dough 2–3 minutes until lightly browned.
Flip and add sauce and toppings.
Cover with dome to melt cheese.
Cook until crust is crisp and cheese melted.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wings
steps: Preheat Blackstone to medium-high (400°F).
Pat wings dry and toss with oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Place wings evenly on griddle. Cook 8–10 minutes per side, turning frequently.
Ensure internal temperature reaches 165°F using a meat thermometer.
Move wings to a cooler zone once fully cooked.
In a small area of the griddle, melt butter and sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Toss wings in garlic butter and sprinkle Parmesan evenly.
Finish with parsley and serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Loaded Breakfast Skillet
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Add oil and spread potatoes evenly.
Cook 12–15 minutes, flipping occasionally until golden and crispy.
Add onion and ham; cook 4–5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Create 6 wells and crack eggs into each.
Cover loosely with dome lid and cook until egg whites are set (160°F internal).
Sprinkle cheese over top and allow to melt before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Surf and Turf
steps: Preheat one zone to high (500°F) and one to medium (400°F).
Season steaks generously with salt and pepper.
Sear steaks 3–4 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 130°F (medium-rare).
Move steaks to cooler zone to rest.
Toss shrimp with salt and cook on medium zone 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 120–125°F.
Add butter and garlic, spoon over shrimp and steak.
Rest steak 5–10 minutes before slicing and serve together.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Buffalo Chicken Sandwich
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Season chicken breasts.
Cook 6–7 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Brush buffalo sauce on both sides during final 2 minutes.
Toast buttered buns on medium zone.
Assemble sandwich with lettuce and chicken.
Serve hot.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Butter Lobster Tails
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Butterfly lobster tails carefully.
Brush with garlic butter and season lightly.
Place shell-side down and cook 5–6 minutes.
Flip briefly to finish meat side.
Cook until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Brush with additional butter before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Smashed Potatoes
steps: Parboil potatoes until fork tender.
Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Place potatoes on surface and smash flat using spatula.
Drizzle oil and season generously.
Cook 5–6 minutes per side until crispy and golden.
Finish with rosemary and serve.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Korean Beef Bulgogi
steps: Marinate beef at least 30 minutes.
Preheat griddle to high (450°F).
Spread beef in single layer.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until browned and caramelized.
Ensure beef reaches 135–140°F.
Serve over rice.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Turkey Smash Burgers
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Form loose balls and smash thin.
Season immediately.
Cook 4–5 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Add cheese during final minute.
Toast buns and assemble.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Fried Rice with Steak
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Cook steak to 130°F then dice.
Scramble eggs separately.
Add vegetables and cook 3–4 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce.
Return steak and combine thoroughly.
Cook until slightly crisped.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Honey Garlic Salmon
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Season salmon lightly.
Cook skin-side down 4–5 minutes.
Flip carefully and cook until internal temp reaches 125–130°F.
In small area, combine honey, soy and garlic until slightly thickened.
Brush glaze over salmon during final minute.
Serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chicken Bacon Ranch Wraps
steps: Preheat one zone of the Blackstone to medium-high (400°F) and another to medium (375°F).
Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Cook chicken 6–7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Move chicken to cooler zone and let rest 5 minutes before slicing.
Cook bacon until crispy (about 6–8 minutes), turning frequently.
Warm tortillas briefly on medium zone.
Layer sliced chicken, bacon, cheese, and ranch inside tortilla.
Fold tightly and place seam-side down on griddle.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until tortilla is golden and crisp.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Add oil and cook shrimp 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 120–125°F. Remove and set aside.
Scramble eggs in separate area and set aside.
Add vegetables and cook 3–4 minutes until tender.
Add rice and break apart with scraper.
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil evenly.
Return shrimp and eggs to mixture.
Cook 4–5 more minutes until rice slightly crisps.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Steak Fajita Bowls
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450°F).
Toss steak with oil and seasoning.
Sear 4–5 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 130°F for medium-rare.
Rest steak 5–10 minutes before slicing thin.
Cook sliced peppers and onions until slightly charred.
Assemble bowls with rice, steak, and vegetables.
Serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone BBQ Pulled Pork Sliders
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Heat pulled pork with BBQ sauce until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Butter buns and toast cut-side down.
Spoon pork onto buns.
Top with coleslaw.
Serve hot.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Cajun Salmon
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Brush salmon lightly with oil and season.
Place skin-side down and cook 4–5 minutes.
Flip carefully and cook until internal temperature reaches 125–130°F.
Rest 2–3 minutes before serving with lemon.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chicken Alfredo Flatbread
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-low (350°F).
Brush flatbread bottom with oil and place on surface.
Cook 2–3 minutes until lightly crisp.
Flip and spread Alfredo sauce evenly.
Top with sliced chicken and mozzarella.
Cover with dome lid until cheese melts completely.
Remove and slice before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Sausage Breakfast Tacos
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook sausage until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Scramble eggs separately until fully cooked (160°F).
Warm tortillas briefly.
Assemble tacos with sausage, eggs, and cheese.
Serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Herb Pork Chops
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Season pork chops generously.
Cook 4–5 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Add butter and garlic during final minute and baste.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Cheeseburger Quesadilla
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook ground beef until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place tortilla on surface and add beef and cheese.
Fold and cook 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.
Slice and serve with pickles.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Teriyaki Steak Bites
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450°F).
Season steak cubes lightly.
Spread evenly and sear 2–3 minutes per side.
Cook until internal temperature reaches 135–140°F.
Add teriyaki sauce and sesame oil during final minute.
Toss quickly and remove immediately to avoid overcooking.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Classic Patty Melt
steps: Preheat one zone to medium (375°F) and another to medium-low.
Add 1 tbsp butter and cook onions slowly for 12–15 minutes until deeply caramelized. Move to cooler zone.
Form 4 thin patties slightly larger than bread slices.
Cook patties on medium zone 3–4 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place bread butter-side down, add cheese, patty, caramelized onions, more cheese, and top bread.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese fully melted.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Lemon Garlic Shrimp Skewers
steps: Soak skewers in water 20 minutes before cooking.
Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Toss shrimp with oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Thread shrimp onto skewers.
Place skewers on griddle and cook 2–3 minutes per side.
Ensure internal temperature reaches 120–125°F.
Remove immediately to avoid overcooking and serve hot.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Breakfast French Toast
steps: Preheat griddle to 350°F (medium-low).
Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in shallow dish.
Dip bread slices evenly, allowing excess to drip off.
Melt butter on surface.
Cook bread 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Ensure internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Serve immediately with syrup.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Philly Chicken Cheesesteak
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Add oil and cook onions and peppers 6–8 minutes.
Push vegetables aside.
Add chicken in single layer and season.
Cook 6–7 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Mix vegetables into chicken.
Divide into portions, top with cheese, allow to melt.
Transfer to toasted hoagie rolls.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Cajun Chicken Alfredo
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Season chicken with Cajun seasoning.
Cook 6–7 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Remove and slice.
Lower heat to medium (375°F).
Melt butter and sauté garlic 30 seconds.
Add heavy cream and simmer 3–4 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan until thickened.
Return sliced chicken to sauce and coat evenly.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Bacon Smash Burgers
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450–500°F).
Cook bacon until crispy; set aside.
Form loose beef balls and smash thin.
Season immediately.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Add cheese during final minute.
Toast buns and assemble with bacon.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Grilled Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Cook chicken 5–6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Brush with teriyaki sauce during last 2 minutes.
Grill pineapple rings 2–3 minutes per side until caramelized.
Serve chicken topped with grilled pineapple.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Loaded Hash Browns
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Spread hash browns evenly with oil.
Cook 8–10 minutes without moving until crispy.
Flip carefully and cook another 6–8 minutes.
Top with bacon and cheese.
Cover with dome lid until cheese melts fully.
Finish with green onions.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Butter Scallops
steps: Pat scallops dry thoroughly.
Preheat griddle to medium-high (425°F).
Season scallops lightly.
Place flat side down and sear 2–3 minutes without moving.
Flip and cook 1–2 more minutes until internal temp reaches 125°F.
Add butter and garlic during final minute and baste briefly.
Serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450°F).
Add oil and cook steak 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 135°F.
Move steak to cooler zone.
Add broccoli and cook 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add garlic and stir briefly.
Return steak and drizzle soy, oyster sauce and sesame oil.
Toss thoroughly and cook 1–2 minutes more before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Classic Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Preheat one zone of the griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook sausage patties 4–5 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Move sausage to a cooler zone.
Lightly butter surface and crack eggs into egg rings.
Season lightly and cook until whites are fully set and internal temp reaches 160°F.
Split and toast English muffins cut-side down until golden.
Place cheese slice over sausage to melt slightly.
Assemble sandwich with muffin, sausage, egg, cheese, and top muffin.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Teriyaki Shrimp Stir Fry
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Add oil and cook shrimp 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 120–125°F. Remove and set aside.
Add vegetables and cook 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return shrimp to griddle.
Drizzle teriyaki sauce and sesame oil evenly.
Toss continuously for 1–2 minutes until glaze thickens slightly.
Remove immediately to prevent overcooking.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Southwest Chicken Quesadilla
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Heat chicken, beans, and corn together with taco seasoning until warmed through (internal temp 165°F for chicken).
Lightly butter cooking surface.
Place tortilla flat and spread filling evenly on half.
Add cheese generously.
Fold tortilla and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese fully melted.
Remove and slice into wedges before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Butter New York Strip
steps: Preheat griddle to high (500°F).
Pat steaks dry and season generously.
Place steaks on hot surface and sear 3–4 minutes without moving.
Flip and cook additional 3–4 minutes until internal temp reaches 130°F for medium-rare.
Lower heat slightly and add butter, garlic, and thyme.
Tilt griddle slightly and baste steaks for 1–2 minutes.
Remove and rest 5–10 minutes before slicing.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Loaded Cheesesteak Fries
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Cook onions until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Push onions aside and cook steak 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 135–140°F.
Season lightly.
Combine steak and onions.
Spread fries in foil tray on griddle.
Top fries with steak mixture and cheese.
Cover with dome lid until cheese melts completely.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Honey Mustard Chicken
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Season chicken lightly.
Cook 6–7 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Mix honey and mustard together.
Brush glaze onto chicken during final 2 minutes.
Allow glaze to slightly caramelize.
Rest chicken 5 minutes before slicing.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Veggie Breakfast Scramble
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Melt butter and cook onions and peppers 3–4 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Whisk eggs separately and pour onto griddle.
Scramble continuously until eggs are fully cooked and internal temp reaches 160°F.
Combine vegetables into eggs before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Cajun Steak and Shrimp
steps: Preheat one zone to high (450°F) and one to medium (400°F).
Season steak cubes and sear 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 135–140°F.
Move steak to cooler zone.
Season shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 120–125°F.
Add butter and toss everything together briefly.
Serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Philly Cheesesteak Omelette
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook steak 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 135°F.
Add onions and peppers and cook until softened.
Whisk eggs and pour into buttered surface.
Cook until edges begin to set.
Add steak mixture and cheese to center.
Fold omelette carefully and cook until internal temp reaches 160°F.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Herb Chicken Thighs
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Season thighs evenly.
Cook 5–6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Add garlic and thyme during final 2 minutes.
Allow herbs to release aroma without burning.
Rest chicken 5 minutes before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich
steps: Marinate chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 1 hour.
Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F) and lightly oil surface.
Combine flour, cayenne, paprika and salt.
Dredge chicken thoroughly in seasoned flour.
Cook chicken 6–7 minutes per side until crust forms and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Mix hot oil with extra cayenne to create hot glaze and brush over chicken.
Toast buns on medium zone.
Assemble sandwich with pickles and serve.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chimichurri Skirt Steak
steps: Preheat griddle to high (500°F).
Pat steak dry and season generously.
Sear 3–4 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 130°F for medium-rare.
Rest steak 5–10 minutes.
Prepare chimichurri by mixing parsley, garlic, olive oil and vinegar.
Slice steak against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over sliced steak before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Lobster Grilled Cheese
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Lightly season lobster meat.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place bread butter-side down.
Add cheese, lobster evenly distributed, then top with another slice.
Cook 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese fully melted.
Ensure lobster is heated to 145°F internal temperature.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Birria Tacos
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Dip tortillas lightly in birria consommé.
Place tortilla on griddle and add beef and cheese.
Fold taco and cook 2–3 minutes per side until crispy and golden.
Ensure filling reaches 165°F.
Serve with extra consommé for dipping.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Cajun Lobster and Shrimp
steps: Preheat one zone to medium-high (400°F).
Season seafood lightly.
Cook lobster 4–5 minutes until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Cook shrimp 2–3 minutes per side until 120–125°F.
Add butter and toss together briefly.
Serve immediately.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Stuffed Breakfast Burrito
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook chorizo until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Cook hash browns until crispy.
Scramble eggs until internal temp reaches 160°F.
Layer ingredients inside tortillas.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down 2–3 minutes per side.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Parmesan Steak Bites
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450°F).
Season steak cubes evenly.
Sear 2–3 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 135–140°F.
Add butter and garlic and sauté briefly.
Remove from heat and toss with Parmesan immediately.
Serve hot.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Korean BBQ Chicken
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Cook chicken 5–6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Brush Korean BBQ sauce during last 2 minutes.
Allow sauce to caramelize slightly.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Seafood Paella
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Cook chorizo until internal temp reaches 160°F and remove.
Add oil and toast rice lightly for 2–3 minutes.
Add broth and saffron evenly.
Simmer uncovered 15–18 minutes without stirring.
Add shrimp and mussels on top.
Cook until shrimp reach 120–125°F and mussels open fully.
Allow rice to develop slight crust before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Tomahawk Steak
steps: Preheat one zone to high (500°F) and one to medium (400°F).
Season steak generously and let sit 30 minutes at room temperature.
Sear 4–5 minutes per side on high zone.
Move to medium zone and cook until internal temp reaches 125°F for medium-rare.
Add butter, garlic and rosemary during final minutes and baste.
Rest steak 10 minutes before slicing.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Crunchwrap Supreme
steps: Preheat Blackstone to medium (375°F) creating one hot zone and one cooler zone.
Cook ground beef on the hot zone, breaking it apart with a scraper until fully browned. Continue cooking until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Drain excess grease and mix in taco seasoning with 2–3 tablespoons water. Simmer 2 minutes until thickened.
Warm tortillas briefly on the cooler zone to make them pliable.
Layer beef in the center of tortilla, add nacho cheese, place tostada shell on top, then add sour cream, lettuce, tomatoes and shredded cheese.
Fold edges inward in overlapping pattern to seal.
Place seam-side down on lightly oiled griddle and cook 2–3 minutes until golden brown.
Flip carefully and cook additional 2–3 minutes until crisp and heated through (internal temp at least 165°F).

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Smash Burger Tacos
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450–475°F).
Press a thin layer of ground beef directly onto one side of each tortilla.
Place tortilla beef-side down on hot surface and smash firmly with spatula to create full contact.
Season immediately with salt and pepper.
Cook undisturbed 2–3 minutes until edges crisp and beef reaches 160°F.
Flip tortilla so tortilla side touches surface and add cheese.
Cook 1–2 minutes until cheese melts and tortilla lightly crisps.
Top with onions, pickles and burger sauce before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chicken Street Corn Bowls
steps: Preheat one zone to medium-high (400°F).
Season chicken and cook 5–6 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Move chicken to rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
On medium zone, sauté corn in oil until lightly charred (about 5–6 minutes).
Season corn with chili powder and a squeeze of lime.
Assemble bowls with rice, sliced chicken and charred corn.
Finish with cotija cheese and extra lime.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Hibachi Steak and Vegetables
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (425°F).
Add sesame oil and sear steak cubes in single layer.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 135–140°F.
Move steak to cooler zone.
Add butter and cook vegetables 5–6 minutes until tender but still slightly crisp.
Return steak to vegetables and drizzle soy sauce.
Toss continuously for 1–2 minutes allowing sauce to reduce slightly.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Loaded Chicken Philly Fries
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Cook chicken in single layer until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Add onions and peppers and cook until softened and lightly caramelized.
Spread fries in foil tray on griddle.
Top fries with chicken mixture and provolone cheese.
Cover with dome lid and allow cheese to fully melt before serving.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Breakfast Crunchwrap
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F), setting up one hot zone and one cooler zone.
Cook sausage on the hot zone, breaking apart and cooking until internal temperature reaches 160°F. Move to cooler zone.
Cook hash brown patties until deeply golden and crispy on both sides (about 4–5 minutes per side).
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Pour onto lightly buttered surface and scramble until fully set (internal 160°F).
Warm tortillas briefly to make pliable.
Layer eggs, sausage, hash brown, and cheese in center of tortilla.
Place tostada shell on top and fold tortilla edges inward.
Cook seam-side down 2–3 minutes until golden and sealed. Flip and cook additional 2 minutes.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone BBQ Chicken Flatbread
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-low (350°F).
Brush bottom of flatbread lightly with oil and place on griddle.
Cook 2–3 minutes until underside begins to crisp.
Flip flatbread and spread BBQ sauce evenly.
Add diced chicken (heated to 165°F) and mozzarella.
Top with red onions.
Cover with dome lid and cook until cheese fully melts and bottom is golden crisp.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Bang Bang Shrimp Tacos
steps: Preheat griddle to medium-high (400°F).
Pat shrimp dry and coat lightly in cornstarch.
Add oil to surface and cook shrimp 2–3 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 120–125°F and exterior crisps.
Warm tortillas on cooler zone.
Toss shrimp in bang bang sauce.
Assemble tacos with shrimp and shredded cabbage.
Serve immediately while shrimp remains crisp.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Garlic Butter Mushroom Steak Sandwich
steps: Preheat griddle to high (450°F).
Season steak generously.
Sear 3–4 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 130–135°F.
Rest steak 5–10 minutes before slicing thin.
Lower heat to medium and sauté mushrooms in butter until golden and softened.
Combine sliced steak with mushrooms and heat briefly.
Place mixture into toasted hoagie rolls, top with provolone, and allow cheese to melt.

blackstoneRecipes.title: Blackstone Chicken Bacon Ranch Quesadilla
steps: Preheat griddle to medium (375°F).
Ensure chicken is heated to 165°F before assembling.
Butter cooking surface lightly.
Place tortilla flat and spread ranch lightly over surface.
Add chicken, bacon and cheese evenly.
Fold tortilla in half and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese fully melted.
Allow to rest 1–2 minutes before slicing.
